page_title: LEN 3-2 LYO | Lens v Lyon 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and it's Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+3' Brice Samba leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon).
90+1' Florian Sotoca (Lens) must think that he is playing a different sport because his behaviour has nothing to do with football and the referee has no choice but to show him a straight red card!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Substitution. Clinton Mata did his best and is replaced by Sael Kumbedi (Lyon).
87' It's time for a substitution. Nampalys Mendy (Lens) comes on in place of Neil El Aynaoui.
86' Pierre Sage prepares a substitution. Dejan Lovren is replaced by Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon).
86' Substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) in, Ernest Nuamah out.
83' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
83' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends the corner into the box, but Brice Samba intercepts it and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Looks like Massadio Haidara (Lens) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
81' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the right side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Ruben Aguilar walks off the pitch to be replaced by Massadio Haidara (Lens).

74' 3 - 2 What a goal! Ruben Aguilar plays it to Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Anthony Lopes into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
72' 2 - 2 Jake O'Brien (Lyon) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes with a shot which goes inside the left post.
72' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

71' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Brice Samba pulls off a brilliant save.
71' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
70' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
69' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

65' Facundo Medina (Lens) latches on to a lofted pass from the resulting set piece and pulls the trigger from around the penalty spot. His effort towards the right side of the goal is saved by the excellent Anthony Lopes. Kevin Danso (Lens) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
64' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) replaces Wesley Said.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adrien Thomasson (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that David Costa can be given a rest.
63' Tino Kadewere (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Diego Moreira.
63' Substitution. Paul Akouokou (Lyon) on for Skelly Alvero.
59' Diego Moreira (Lyon) unleashes a close-range volley towards the bottom left corner, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains unchanged.
58' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
57' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' 2 - 1 Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) sends Anthony Lopes the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
52' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) is going to take the penalty!

51' Skelly Alvero (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Clement Turpin with no other option than to blow for a foul. Lens are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
50' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Diego Moreira (Lyon) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.

46' Facundo Medina (Lens) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Anthony Lopes pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Deiver Machado (Lens) is replaced by Przemyslaw Frankowski.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Clement Turpin blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' A clumsy foul by Florian Sotoca (Lens) and Clement Turpin blows his whistle.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Florian Sotoca (Lens) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
43' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Clinton Mata (Lyon) as his effort only hit the wall.
41' Facundo Medina (Lens) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
41' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Facundo Medina (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lyon are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
41' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) hits a volley towards goal, but the ball flies straight at the goalkeeper.
40' David Costa (Lens) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

40' Wesley Said (Lens) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Anthony Lopes, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
37' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is able to continue to play.
36' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
35' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
35' It seemed like Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
35' Deiver Machado (Lens) gets a yellow card.

33' Jake O'Brien (Lyon) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the roof of the net. Brice Samba displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
32' The free kick is taken by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), but ball is cleared.
31' Clement Turpin blows his whistle and signals a foul after Facundo Medina (Lens) brought his opponent down.

26' 1 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Wesley Said (Lens) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent low shot inside the left post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.

26' A big opportunity is wasted by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Anthony Lopes pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
25' Facundo Medina (Lens) is penalised for holding. Clement Turpin signals a set piece. A free kick has been awarded to Lyon.
24' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:2. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 0:1.
20' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Deiver Machado (Lens) on the edge of the box.
19' One of the Lyon players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Lens earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

15' 0 - 1 Ernest Nuamah produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Jake O'Brien (Lyon) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the middle of the net. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
15' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
13' David Costa (Lens) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
13' David Costa (Lens) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. Now Lens have a corner.
12' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by David Costa (Lens), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
11' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Lens win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
7' David Costa (Lens) and Wesley Said try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
5' Salis Abdul Samed (Lens) tries to find Deiver Machado, but he puts too much power on the pass. It's a throw-in for Lyon.
2' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Diego Moreira (Lyon), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lyon will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
